noah-billing: quick one 10K invoice for Acme Labs (ACME-77) INV-8120 bounced via ACH: bank returned 'account_closed'.

tara-finance: oof. decline code `acct_closed` typically means they closed the account. Did we try card on file?

noah-billing: they didn't have a card on file, only ACH. return id `rtn_7c4b2`.

leo-cs: reaching out to Acme now to confirm new payment details. offering wire for immediate settlement.

ops-bot: Created task FIN-4821 to follow up and flag contract hold if not resolved in 5 business days.

noah-billing: also pinging sales to confirm legal entity (some customers pay from a parent acct). last time mismatch caused bank to reject.

tara-finance: add note: allow manual payment via credit card if their billing contact authorizes over a recorded payment link. get approval from Maria for any late fee exceptions.

leo-cs: Acme replied 10K is urgent, they'll wire but need our intermediary bank info for international routing. I'll send the wire template.

noah-billing: logging return id `rtn_7c4b2`, task FIN-4821. will update when receipt posted.
